data.title: Ethereum price nears resistance at $2,530 amid ... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum rallied to $2,667 on September 11 but retraced 11.6% to $2,356 within four days, currently trading near $2,495 and approaching a local resistance at $2,530. Investor caution follows recent rate hikes, which could tighten liquidity and increase market risk. Ethereum ETF outflows of $407.3 million over three days indicate short-term bearish pressure. However, lower transaction costs and recovering network participation suggest potential bullish signs. Traders should watch the $2,380-$2,530 range closely, as a breakout or dip could signal significant moves, emphasizing the need for careful risk management.
data.author: AMBCrypto
